name: General Education
description: Foundational academic competencies that may be shared across teacher licensure and other general examinations.

name: Professional Education
description: Teaching profession foundations, curriculum, pedagogy, assessment, learner development, and professional practice.

name: English
description: English language proficiency, grammar, vocabulary, reading, literature, writing, and communication.

name: Filipino
description: Wikang Filipino, pagbasa, pagsulat, panitikan, gramatika, at komunikasyon.

name: Mathematics
description: Number sense, algebra, geometry, measurement, statistics, probability, and mathematical reasoning.

name: Science
description: Life science, physical science, earth and space science, and scientific reasoning.

name: Social Studies
description: History, geography, government, economics, culture, society, and civic understanding.

name: Elementary Education
description: Integrated elementary-level teaching content and pedagogy for broad elementary education preparation.

name: Early Childhood Education
description: Development, learning, care, curriculum, assessment, and family engagement for young children.

name: Special Needs Education
description: Inclusive education, learner support, assessment, intervention, and collaboration for diverse learning needs.

name: Verbal Ability
description: Vocabulary, grammar, reading comprehension, and verbal reasoning skills used in general aptitude examinations.

name: Numerical Ability
description: Arithmetic, quantitative reasoning, number relationships, and practical numerical problem solving.

name: General Information
description: Civics, Philippine government, current affairs, and broad public knowledge for general examinations.

name: Clerical Ability
description: Filing, spelling, alphabetizing, office procedures, and clerical accuracy skills.
